issues.text: Windows only: there is no Ubuntu build yet.
The free p4 command-line client from Perforce is still needed. Ropework will have its own client.
USD models are shown but their animation is not played.
A model's textures are found only in the same folder as the model.
Houdini files cannot be shown in the 3D view; Maya and Blender files can.
Unreal asset thumbnails are not shown; the file shows a plain icon and Open in your editor.
Comparing two versions works for models the viewer reads directly, not for Blender or Maya files.
Streams, the PDF viewer, studio profiles, extensions and the Review workspace are not built yet.
